draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.65, the 230th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 34th of 35 at WR. He went 229th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (20th percentile). College production: his final season (2019) ranked 3rd in receiving yards among the 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2023. 23 career games and 1 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 0 AV in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (5th percentile), team target share 0.6% (5th percentile). Played 4 of 17 games in 2023.
